stem: The positive number \(a\) is \(20\%\) greater than the positive number \(b\). If \(a\) is decreased by \(10\%\) and \(b\) is increased by \(8\%\), the new value of \(a\) is what percent of the new value of \(b\)?
solution: The new values are equal, so the new value of \(a\) is \(100\%\) of the new value of \(b\).
verify:
b = symbols('b', positive=True)
v = simplify(Rational(90, 100) * Rational(120, 100) * b / (Rational(108, 100) * b) * 100)
assert v == 100
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == v
